mapper.sql: RPT_ID AS rptId, WEEK_YMD AS weekYmd, SR_NO AS srNo, SR_TITL AS srTitl, REG_EMPNO AS regEmpno, DEPT_CD AS deptCd, PART_CD AS partCd, RPT_CNTT AS rptCntt, PLAN_DATE AS planDate, SR_PLAN_DATE AS srPlanDate, DELAY_RSN AS delayRsn, LEADER_CMT AS leaderCmt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DASH_WKLY_RPT (WEEK_YMD, SR_NO, SR_TITL, REG_EMPNO, DEPT_CD, PART_CD, RPT_CNTT, PLAN_DATE, SR_PLAN_DATE, DELAY_RSN, CREATED_BY) VALUES (#{weekYmd}, #{srNo}, #{srTitl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{regEmpno}, #{deptCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{partCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rptCntt}, #{planDate}, #{srPlanDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{delayRsn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE DASH_WKLY_RPT SET RPT_CNTT = #{rptCntt}, PLAN_DATE = #{planDate}, SR_PLAN_DATE = #{srPlanDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DELAY_RSN = #{delayRsn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{actor} WHERE RPT_ID = #{rptId}
mapper.sql: SUM_ID AS sumId, WEEK_YMD AS weekYmd, DEPT_CD AS deptCd, PART_CD AS partCd, SUM_CNTT AS sumCntt, REG_EMPNO AS regEmpno, TEAM_CMT AS teamCmt, TEAM_CMT_EMPNO AS teamCmtEmpno
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DASH_WKLY_SUM (WEEK_YMD, DEPT_CD, PART_CD, SUM_CNTT, REG_EMPNO, CREATED_BY) VALUES (#{weekYmd}, #{deptCd}, #{partCd}, #{sumCntt}, #{regEmpno}, #{actor})
INSERT INTO DASH_WKLY_SUM_RPT (SUM_ID, RPT_ID) SELECT #{sumId}, RPT_ID FROM DASH_WKLY_RPT WHERE RPT_ID IN #{rptId}
mapper.select: SELECT RPT_ID AS rptId, WEEK_YMD AS weekYmd, DEPT_CD AS deptCd, PART_CD AS partCd FROM DASH_WKLY_RPT WHERE RPT_ID IN #{rptId}

SELECT L.SUM_ID AS sumId, R.RPT_ID AS rptId, R.SR_NO AS srNo, R.SR_TITL AS srTitl, R.REG_EMPNO AS regEmpno, R.RPT_CNTT AS rptCntt, R.PLAN_DATE AS planDate, R.SR_PLAN_DATE AS srPlanDate, R.DELAY_RSN AS delayRsn, R.LEADER_CMT AS leaderCmt FROM DASH_WKLY_SUM_RPT L JOIN DASH_WKLY_RPT R ON R.RPT_ID = L.RPT_ID WHERE L.SUM_ID IN #{sumId} ORDER BY L.SUM_ID, R.RPT_ID
